name: Tharun Moorthy
bio: Tharun Moorthy is an Indian filmmaker acclaimed for his realistic and socially conscious storytelling in Malayalam cinema. He debuted with Operation Java (2021), followed by the National Award winning Saudi Vellakka (2022), and continued his strong run with Thudarum (2025).

credits.title: Athimanoharam
credits.overview: Sub-Inspector T. S. Lovelajan and his family navigate the grueling psychological toll of law enforcement as demanding professional duties directly clash with domestic life.

credits.title: Thudarum
credits.overview: A taxi driver finds himself embroiled in a dangerous conspiracy after his car is confiscated by a corrupt police officer.

credits.title: Saudi Vellakka
credits.overview: Abhilash Sasidharan receives a summons warrant to appear in court for a case from his childhood. Desperate to learn the truth, he finds a small conflict snowballed into a larger one that changed the lives of everyone involved

credits.title: Operation Java
credits.overview: B. Tech graduates Antony and Vinay Dasan are talented, but unemployed. That changes, however, when they approach the cyber cell with a new perspective to a film piracy case.

credits.title: Thrissivaperoor Kliptham
credits.overview: All that David Pauly ever wanted in life was to witness the downfall of his high school nemesis Chembaden Joey. When Joey louses up Davy's betrothal ceremony, Davy and his friends vow to scheme up something that would button up Joey forever.
